summary: A guide for the first workshop day: run the preflight, integrate your three projects into one repository a stranger can run (a checklist and a real example: 216 tracked files, nothing junk), polish only what a check or a stranger finds, practise, demo for the room in three minutes, collect feedback on a sheet, triage it and make at most three fixes. The workshop itself is a live event and was not run by the author.

items.text: Run your preflight or demo check and write your honest sentence on a card
Go through the integration checklist until a stranger gets everything from one link
Read git status before every commit and check that nothing junk or secret is tracked
Rehearse the demo twice aloud, the second time without stopping
Give your three-minute demo to the room and write the feedback sheet for the others
Triage your feedback and make at most three fixes, then run the preflight again
Play the Integration Check game to the end and see your score
